title: The Vision of God
author: Nicholas of Cusa (Salter trans)
description: Nicholas of Cusa uses the image of an all-seeing gaze to explore the relationship between divine vision and human understanding. This contemplative work joins philosophical reflection with an invitation to encounter God beyond ordinary conceptual limits.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/visionofgod00nich).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
